title: Tor Updates DoS Defenses Again as Relay Attacks Continue
description: Tor Project released version 0.4.9.17 to patch several security issues, including improvements to built-in DoS protections related to IPv6, amid an ongoing distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack targeting its volunteer relay network. The attack has overwhelmed many relays with a massive flood of client circuits, causing relay unresponsiveness and loss of HSDir status for some. Despite the update, relay operators report continued disruptions and evolving attack techniques. The Tor Project is considering additional defenses and urges relay operators to update promptly.
